title: LQR House Inc.
text: EX-10.1 2 ea031342201ex10-1.htm EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT, DATED NOVEMBER 19, 2026, BY AND BETWEEN LQR HOUSE INC. AND LIHONG LEO CHEN Exhibit 10.1 EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT THIS EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT (the “ Agreement ”) is made and entered into as of November 19, 2026 by and between Lihong Leo Chen , an individual (the “ Executive ”), and LQR House Inc. , a Delaware corporation (the “ Company ”). WHEREAS, the Company desires to employ the Executive on the terms and conditions set forth herein; and WHEREAS, the Executive desires to be employed by the Company on such terms and conditions. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, promises, and obligations set forth herein, the parties agree as follows: 1. Term . The Executive’s employment hereunder was effective as of October 16, 2026 (the “ Effective Date ”) and shall continue until the second anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated earlier pursuant to Section 5 of this Agreement; provided that on the second anniversary of this Agreement and each annual anniversary thereafter (such date and each annual anniversary thereof, a “ Renewal Date ”), the Agreement shall be deemed to be automatically extended, upon the same terms and conditions, for successive periods of one year, unless either party provides written notice of its intention not to extend the term of the Agreement at least 90 days prior to the applicable Renewal Date. The period during which the Executive is employed by the Company hereunder is hereinafter referred to as the “ Employment Term ”. 2. Position . During the Employment Term, the Executive shall serve as the Chief Executive Officer of the Company, reporting to the Board of Directors of the Company (the “ Board ”). In such position, the Executive shall have such duties, authority, and responsibility as shall be determined from time to time by the Board, which duties, authority, and responsibility are consistent with the Executive’s position and initially include the following: (a) The Executive’s primary responsibilities include helping to shape the strategic vision for the company, implementing the appropriate company structure, defining the core business objectives, making major corporate decisions, directing and managing the overall operations and resources of the Company, acting as the main point of communication between the Board and corporate operations, and being the public face of the Company, in each case subject to, and in accordance with, applicable laws and regulations. (b) The Executive will faithfully, honestly, and diligently serve the Company, cooperate with the Board, and utilize his professional skill and care to ensure that all services rendered hereunder are to the satisfaction of the Board, acting reasonably. The Executive will provide any other services not specifically mentioned herein but which, by reason of the Executive’s capability, the Executive knows or ought to know to be necessary to ensure that the best interests of the Company are maintained at all times. (c) The Executive will assume, obey, implement, and execute such duties, directions, responsibilities, procedures, policies, and lawful orders as may be determined or given from time to time by the Board. (d) The Executive will report the results of his duties hereunder to the Board as it may request from time to time. 3. Place of Performance . The Executive is permitted to perform his duties remotely and is not required to attend the Company’s principal place of business or any other office or workplace of the Employer in person as a condition of employment. The Executive may perform his duties from an agreed remote work location, subject to the Employee continuing to fulfill the Chief Executive Officer’s duties and responsibilities under this Agreement and complying with the Company’s applicable policies and procedures. Any requirement for the Executive to attend the Company’s premises or another location in person shall be subject to mutual agreement between the Company and the Executive, unless otherwise required by applicable law. 4. Compensation . 4.1 Base Salary . From the Effective Date, the Executive’s salary shall be US$10,000 per month. The salary provided for in this Section 4 shall be paid in periodic installments in accordance with the Company’s customary payroll practices and applicable wage payment laws, but no less frequently than monthly. The Executive’s base salary shall be reviewed at least annually by the Board, and the Board may, but shall not be required to, increase or decrease the base salary during the Employment Term. The Executive’s base salary, as in effect from time to time, is hereinafter referred to as “ Base Salary ”. For the avoidance of doubt, the Base Salary payable to the Executive pursuant to this Agreement may be paid by the Company’s Hong Kong subsidiary or affiliate on behalf of the Company, and any such amounts so paid shall satisfy the corresponding payment obligations of the Company under this Section 4.1. 4.2 Annual Bonus . For each financial year of the Employment Term, the Executive shall be eligible to receive an annual bonus (the “ Annual Bonus ”). However, the decision to provide any Annual Bonus and the amount and terms of any Annual Bonus shall be in the sole and absolute discretion of the Board. For the avoidance of doubt, the Annual Bonus payable to the Executive pursuant to this Agreement may be paid by the Company’s Hong Kong subsidiary or affiliate on behalf of the Company, and any such amounts so paid shall satisfy the corresponding payment obligations of the Company under this Section 4.2. 4.3 Equity Awards . In consideration of the Executive entering into this Agreement and as an inducement to join the Company, the Company may, subject to approval by the Board or the Compensation Committee and the adoption and effectiveness of an applicable equity incentive plan, grant the Executive equity awards, including stock options or other equity-based awards, on such terms and conditions as may be determined by the Board or the Compensation Committee in its discretion. Any such awards shall be subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable equity incentive plan and the applicable award agreement. 4.4 Benefits and Perquisites . During the Employment Term, the Executive shall be entitled to benefits and perquisites consistent in accordance with the practices of the Company and to the extent the Company provides similar benefits or perquisites (or both) to similarly situated executives of the Company. 4.5 Employee Benefits . During the Employment Term, the Executive shall be entitled to participate in all employee benefit plans, practices, and programs maintained by the Company, as in effect from time to time (collectively, “ Employee Benefit Plans ”), on a basis which is no less favorable than is provided to other similarly situated executives of the Company, to the extent consistent with applicable law and the terms of the applicable Employee Benefit Plans. The Company reserves the right to amend or cancel any Employee Benefit Plans at any time in its sole discretion, subject to the terms of such Employee Benefit Plan and applicable law. 4.6 Vacation; Paid Time-Off . During the Employment Term, the Executive will be entitled to paid vacation on a basis that is at least as favorable as that provided to other similarly situated executives of the Company, but no less than 23 days per year. The Executive shall receive other paid time off in accordance with the Company’s policies for executive officers as such policies may exist from time to time. Up to five vacation days not used by the end of a calendar year may be carried over to the following calendar year and must be used during that following calendar year. Any vacation days that are accrued will be compensated as a lump sum at the Executive’s then current salary upon the termination of this Agreement, including at the end of the Employment Term. 4.7 Business Expenses . The Executive shall be entitled to reimbursement for all reasonable and necessary out-of-pocket business, entertainment, and travel expenses incurred by the Executive in connection with the performance of the Executive’s duties hereunder in accordance with the Company’s expense reimbursement policies and procedures. 4.8 Indemnification . In the event that the Executive is made a party or threatened to be made a party to any action, suit, or proceeding, whether civil, criminal, administrative, or investigative (a “ Proceeding ”), other than any Proceeding initiated by the Executive or the Company related to any contest or dispute between the Executive and the Company or any of its affiliates with respect to this Agreement, or the Executive’s employment hereunder, by reason of the fact that the Executive is or was a director or officer of the Company or any affiliate of the Company, or is or was serving at the request of the Company as a director, officer, member, employee, or agent of another corporation or a partnership, joint venture, trust, or other enterprise, the Executive shall be indemnified and held harmless by the Company to the fullest extent applicable to any other officer or director of the Company from and against any liabilities, costs, claims, and expenses, including all costs and expenses incurred in defense of any Proceeding (including attorneys’ fees). 2 5. Termination of Employment . The Employment Term, and the Executive’s employment hereunder may be terminated by either the Company or the Executive at any time and for any reason; provided that, unless otherwise provided herein, either party shall be required to give the other party at least 30 days’ advance written notice of any termination of the Executive’s employment. Upon termination of the Executive’s employment during the Employment Term, the Executive shall be entitled to the compensation and benefits described in this Section 5 and shall have no further rights to any compensation or any other benefits from the Company or any of its affiliates. 5.1 Expiration of the Term, for Cause or Without Good Reason . The Executive’s employment hereunder may be terminated upon either party’s failure to renew the Agreement in accordance with Section 1, by the Company for Cause or by the Executive without Good Reason. (a) If the Executive’s employment is terminated upon either party’s failure to renew the Agreement, by the Company for Cause or by the Executive without Good Reason, the Executive shall be entitled to receive: (i) any accrued but unpaid Base Salary and accrued but unused vacation, which shall be paid on the Termination Date (as defined below); (ii) any unpaid and accrued (back) salary (not covered by (i) above) from the period of the Effective Date through and including the date of termination. (iii) reimbursement for unreimbursed business expenses properly incurred by the Executive, which shall be subject to and paid in accordance with the Company’s expense reimbursement policy; and (iv) such employee benefits (including vested equity compensation), if any, to which the Executive may be entitled under the Company’s employee benefit plans as of the Termination Date; provided that in no event shall the Executive be entitled to any payments in the nature of severance or termination payments except as specifically provided herein. Items 5.1(a)(i) through 5.1(a)(iv) are referred to herein collectively as the “ Accrued Amounts ”. (b) In the case of termination by the Company for cause or by the Executive without good reason, and in the case of the party’s failure to renew the Agreement, unvested options shall terminate. (c) For purposes of this Agreement, “ Cause ” shall mean: (i) the Executive’s willful failure to perform his duties (other than as a result of incapacity due to physical or mental illness) after the Executive has received ten days’ notice of such failure; (ii) the Executive’s willful failure to comply with any valid and legal directive of the Board after the Executive has received ten days’ notice of his failure to comply with such directive; (iii) the Executive’s willful engagement in dishonesty, illegal conduct, gross negligence, willful misconduct, or conduct involving a material conflict of interest, which is, in each case, materially injurious to the Company or its affiliates; (iv) the Executive’s embezzlement, misappropriation, or fraud, whether or not related to the Executive’s employment with the Company; (v) the Executive’s conviction of, or plea of, guilty or nolo contendere to a crime that constitutes a felony (or state or foreign law equivalent) or a crime that constitutes a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude; 3 (vi) the Executive’s violation of a material policy of the Company; (vii) the Executive’s willful unauthorized disclosure of Confidential Information (as defined below); (viii) the Executive’s material breach of any material obligation under this Agreement or any other written agreement between the Executive and the Company; (ix) any material failure by the Executive to comply with the Company’s written policies or rules, as they may be in effect from time to time during the Employment Term, if such failure causes material reputational or financial harm to the Company; (x) the Executive’s engagement in any business activity that competes with the business of the Company or any of its affiliates, or the Executive’s improper diversion of any corporate opportunity, in each case in violation of any fiduciary, contractual, or other legal obligation owed to the Company; [SIGNATURE PAGE FOLLOWS] 11 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this Agreement as of the date first above written. LQR HOUSE INC. title: Borealis Foods Inc.
text: EX-10.1 2 ea031346801ex10-1.htm OMNIBUS AMENDMENT, TERMINATION AND CONSENT AGREEMENT, DATED AS OF NOVEMBER 19, 2026, AMONG PALMETTO GOURMET FOODS, INC., PGF REAL ESTATE I, INC Exhibit 10.1 EXECUTION VERSION OMNIBUS AMENDMENT, TERMINATION AND CONSENT AGREEMENT This Omnibus Amendment, Termination and Consent Agreement (this “ Agreement ”) is dated as of November 19, 2026 and is among: (1) PALMETTO GOURMET FOODS, INC., a South Carolina corporation (“ PGF ”), PGF REAL ESTATE I, INC., a South Carolina corporation (“ PGF Real Estate I ”), and PGF REAL ESTATE II, INC., a South Carolina corporation (“ PGF Real Estate II ” and, together with PGF and PGF Real Estate I, the “ Borrowers ”); (2) BOREALIS FOODS INC., an Ontario corporation (“ Borealis ”), BOREALIS IP INC., a Canadian federal corporation (“ Borealis IP ”), and PALMETTO GOURMET FOODS (CANADA) INC., a Canadian federal corporation (“ Palmetto Canada ” and, together with Borealis and Borealis IP, the “ Guarantors ” and, the Guarantors together with the Borrowers, the “ Loan Parties ”); (3) SAULE ALGAZIYEVA (referred to as “Algaziyeva Saule” in the Loan Assignment and the Note Assignment), in her capacity as lender under the Credit Agreement and as holder of the Saule Note (the “ Lender ”); (4) OXUS CAPITAL PTE LTD., a Singapore company (“ Oxus ”); (5) REZA SOLTANZADEH (“ Soltanzadeh ”); (6) BARTHELEMY HELG (“ Helg ”); (7) Z VENTURES INC., an Ontario corporation (“ Z Ventures ”); and (8) ZAGROS ALPINE CAPITAL ULC, a British Columbia unlimited liability company (“ Zagros ” and, together with Oxus, Soltanzadeh, Helg and Z Ventures, the “ Shareholder Parties ”). RECITALS A. The Loan Parties and Oxus, as lender, entered into a Credit Agreement dated April 27, 2026 (as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified before the date of this Agreement, the “ Credit Agreement ”), under which Oxus made a term loan in the original principal amount of US$17,000,000, evidenced by a term note dated April 27, 2026 (the “ Facility Note ”). The Credit Agreement provides for a stated maturity of April 27, 2031. B. The Loan Parties, Oxus, Soltanzadeh and Helg entered into a Conversion Agreement dated April 27, 2026 (the “ Conversion Agreement ”), which is the “Specified Conversion Agreement” referred to in the Credit Agreement. Z Ventures and Zagros, which hold the promissory notes evidencing the Indebtedness (as defined in the Conversion Agreement) attributed to Soltanzadeh in Exhibit A to the Conversion Agreement, also signed the Conversion Agreement. C. By an Assignment of Loan Documents dated as of July 31, 2026 (the “ Loan Assignment ”), Oxus assigned to the Lender all of its right, title and interest in, to and under the Credit Agreement, the Facility Note and the other Loan Documents, and the Loan Parties acknowledged the Lender as “Lender” for all purposes of the Loan Documents. Furthermore, by an Assignment of Convertible Promissory Note dated as of July 31, 2026 (the “ Note Assignment ”), Oxus also assigned to the Lender the convertible promissory note dated May 29, 2026 issued by Borealis in the original principal amount of US$3,000,000 (the “ Saule Note ”). Oxus retained the two promissory notes listed for it in Annex A. D. The Conversion Agreement provided for the Automatic Conversion of the Indebtedness into Shares if the Required Equity Financing was not completed by July 1, 2026 (the “ Equity Raise Deadline ”). The Required Equity Financing was not completed. E. Concurrently with this Agreement, Borealis, PGF (as applicable), the holders of the Shareholder Notes and the Lender are entering into the five amendments listed in Annex A. The Note Amendments (as defined below) set a three-year maturity for the Shareholder Notes and stop further interest from accruing on them. The Saule Note Amendment (as defined below) extends the maturity of the Saule Note to May 1, 2027 and otherwise leaves its terms unchanged. This Agreement also extends the 30-day monthly financial and collateral reporting deadlines under the Credit Agreement to 45 days. F. The parties intend that this Agreement, the Note Amendments and the Saule Note Amendment close together. The parties further wish to (i) confirm that the Automatic Conversion did not occur, (ii) terminate the Conversion Agreement, (iii) amend the Credit Agreement to remove the provisions relating to the Conversion Agreement and to confirm the status of the Shareholder Notes and the Saule Note as Permitted Indebtedness, (iv) extend the 30-day monthly reporting deadlines to 45 days, and (v) record the Lender’s consents and waivers relating to these transactions, in each case on the terms of this Agreement. In consideration of the mutual agreements in this Agreement and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, the parties agree as follows: ARTICLE 1 – INTERPRETATION 1.1 Defined Terms. Capitalized terms used but not defined in this Agreement have the meanings given to them in the Credit Agreement or the Conversion Agreement, as applicable. In this Agreement: (a) “ Amended Credit Agreement ” means the Credit Agreement as amended by this Agreement. (b) “ Effective Date ” means the date on which all of the conditions in Section 8.1 have been satisfied. (c) “ Note Amendments ” means, collectively: (i) the Master Amendment to Promissory Notes among Helg, Borealis and PGF; (ii) the Master Amendment to Promissory Notes between Z Ventures and Borealis; (iii) the Master Amendment to Promissory Notes between Zagros and Borealis; and (iv) the Master Amendment to Promissory Notes between Oxus and Borealis, each in the form executed for the closing of this Agreement and dated as of the Effective Date. 2 (d) “ Saule Note Amendment ” means the Amendment No. 1 to Convertible Promissory Note between the Lender, as holder of the Saule Note, and Borealis, in the form executed for the closing of this Agreement and dated as of the Effective Date. (e) “ Shareholder Notes ” means the promissory notes identified in Schedule A to each Note Amendment and summarized in Annex A. 1.2 Interpretation. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation. “Including” means “including without limitation”. References to Articles, Sections and Annexes are to those of this Agreement unless otherwise stated. Annex A forms part of this Agreement. “US$” means United States dollars and “C$” means Canadian dollars. Amounts in different currencies are not added together. 1.3 Capacities. The Lender signs this Agreement both as Lender under the Credit Agreement and as holder of the Saule Note, and her agreements in each capacity are separate. Oxus signs as the original lender under the Credit Agreement, as holder of the two Shareholder Notes it retained and as a party to the Conversion Agreement; it does not resume the role of lender. Soltanzadeh’s signature on behalf of a corporation is separate from his signature in his personal capacity. ARTICLE 2 – ACKNOWLEDGMENTS REGARDING THE CONVERSION AGREEMENT 2.1 Automatic Conversion Did Not Occur. Each Loan Party acknowledges and agrees that: (a) the Required Equity Financing was not completed on or before the Equity Raise Deadline; (b) [Reserved]; (c) the Automatic Conversion did not occur and will not occur, and no Conversion Shares have been or will be issued, or entered in the securities register of Borealis, under the Conversion Agreement; (d) despite Section 1.3(c) of the Conversion Agreement, no Shareholder Party is or has been a shareholder of record of any Conversion Shares; and (e) despite Sections 3.3 and 4.2 of the Conversion Agreement, no Indebtedness has been satisfied, discharged or extinguished, in whole or in part, by the operation of the Conversion Agreement. 3 2.2 Status of Shareholder Notes. Each of Borealis and PGF acknowledges that each Shareholder Note (in each case, as amended by the applicable Note Amendment) issued by it is outstanding and is a valid and binding obligation of that Loan Party, enforceable against such Loan Party in accordance with its terms, and that such Loan Party has no defenses, setoffs, counterclaims, rights of recoupment or other claims with respect to its obligations under such Shareholder Note. Each Shareholder Note continues as debt of its issuer to its holder, subject to any payments actually made on it and to the subordination and payment restrictions in favor of the Lender under the Amended Credit Agreement and any applicable Subordination Agreement. This Agreement does not revive any amount already paid or create any debt in addition to the Shareholder Notes. The issuer of each Shareholder Note is the Loan Party named as maker on that note, as identified in Schedule A to the applicable Note Amendment. Any different allocation of the Shareholder Notes among the Loan Parties in Exhibit A to the Conversion Agreement or Schedule 6.1 to the Credit Agreement was descriptive only and does not change the issuer of any Shareholder Note or the liability of any Loan Party for it. Nothing in this Agreement affects any intercompany account between Borealis and PGF. ARTICLE 3 – TERMINATION OF THE CONVERSION AGREEMENT 3.1 Termination. On the Effective Date, the parties to the Conversion Agreement hereby agree to terminate the Conversion Agreement by mutual written consent. The termination is effective despite Section 6.1 of the Conversion Agreement and the passing of the Equity Raise Deadline, and each party to the Conversion Agreement waives any requirement that the Conversion Agreement be terminated only before the Equity Raise Deadline or only in the manner set out in Section 6.1 of the Conversion Agreement. The Lender and Oxus each agree to the termination to the extent either holds any right under the Conversion Agreement, whether directly or as an assignee. 3.2 Effect of Termination. The termination of the Conversion Agreement does not affect the conversion rights under the Saule Note, which remain unchanged. The rights of the Lender under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, including, but not limited to, the Lender’s rights to convert Year 1 Interest under Section 2.2 of the Credit Agreement, remain in full force and effect, subject to the amendments, consents and waivers expressly provided in this Agreement. ARTICLE 4 – AMENDMENTS TO THE CREDIT AGREEMENT 4.1 Amendments. The Loan Parties and the Lender agree that, effective on the Effective Date, the Credit Agreement is amended as follows: (a) Event of Default. Section 8.1(l) of the Credit Agreement is amended by deleting Section 8.1(l) in its entirety and replacing it with “(l) [Reserved].” The other paragraphs of Section 8.1 are not renumbered. (b) Monthly Reporting. Section 2 (Monthly Financial Statements) and the introductory language of Section 7(a) (Collateral Reports) of Schedule 5.1 to the Credit Agreement are each amended by replacing “30 days” with “45 days”. The requirements to deliver the Compliance Certificate under Section 4 and the reconciliations under Section 7(b) of Schedule 5.1 concurrently with the monthly financial statements continue to apply by reference to the monthly financial statements delivered under Section 2 as amended by this Agreement. This paragraph applies to the monthly financial statements and collateral reports for each fiscal month ending on or after August 31, 2026. All other reporting deadlines remain unchanged. 4 4.2 References; Loan Document. On and after the Effective Date, each reference in the Credit Agreement to “this Agreement”, “hereunder”, “hereof” or words of similar meaning, and each reference in any other Loan Document to the Credit Agreement, means the Amended Credit Agreement. This Agreement constitutes a Loan Document for all purposes of the Amended Credit Agreement. To the extent the Conversion Agreement is a Loan Document, it ceases to be one on the Effective Date, and no reference to it in any Loan Document requires it to remain in effect or to be performed. 4.3 No Other Amendments; No Novation. Except as expressly amended by this Article 4 , the Credit Agreement, the Facility Note and the other Loan Documents remain unchanged and in full force and effect, including the Maturity Date and the interest and repayment terms of the Term Loan. The Note Amendments do not apply to the Facility Note. This Agreement does not novate, discharge or constitute a repayment of any of the Obligations, and the guarantees and Liens securing the Obligations continue with their existing priority, each of which continue in full force and effect. ARTICLE 5 – CONSENTS AND WAIVERS OF THE LENDER 5.1 Waiver of Specified Matters. Subject to the satisfaction of the conditions in Section 8.1 herein, effective on the Effective Date, to the extent that any Default or Event of Default has occurred or may have occurred solely as a result of: (a) the Automatic Conversion not occurring and the Conversion Shares not being issued or delivered under the Conversion Agreement, (b) the nonpayment, prior to the Effective Date, of any Shareholder Note or the Saule Note that is being amended in connection with this Agreement, or (c) any failure to give notice under the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document of any matter described in clauses (a) or (b) , the Lender hereby irrevocably waives each such Default or Event of Default and any rights or remedies arising solely therefrom. 5.2 Limited Effect. The waiver of the matters set forth in clauses (a) through (c) in Article 5.1 herein (collectively, the “ Specified Matters ”) is a one-time and limited accommodation to the matters addressed expressly stated herein. Except for the matters waived under Section 5.1 herein, the Lender does not waive any other Default or Event of Default, whether existing now or arising later, or any other right of the Lender under the Loan Documents, and the waiver set forth herein does not establish a course of dealing. ARTICLE 6 – SUBORDINATION AND LIABILITY 6.1 Continuing Subordination. Each Shareholder Party that is a party to a Subordination Agreement with respect to any Shareholder Note confirms that the Subordination Agreement remains in full force and effect and applies to that Shareholder Note as amended by the applicable Note Amendment and, to the extent its consent is required under that Subordination Agreement, consents to that Note Amendment. 5 6.2 Amended Maturities. The Lender consents to the amended maturity dates of the Shareholder Notes and the Saule Note, notwithstanding that they precede the Maturity Date, and waives any restriction on those dates under the Credit Agreement or, to the extent of her rights, any applicable Subordination Agreement. This consent and waiver do not affect the rights of any other person. Payments under those notes remain subject to the Amended Credit Agreement and any applicable Subordination Agreement. 6.3 No New Liability. By signing this Agreement, no Shareholder Party becomes a borrower, guarantor or grantor of security for the Obligations or for another party’s debt, and no Loan Party becomes liable for a Shareholder Note or the Saule Note that it did not issue. ARTICLE 7 – REAFFIRMATION AND REPRESENTATIONS 7.1 Reaffirmation by Loan Parties. Each Loan Party (a) confirms its obligations under the Amended Credit Agreement and each other Loan Document to which it is a party, including, in the case of each Guarantor, its guarantee under Section 2.8 of the Credit Agreement; (b) confirms that each Lien granted by it under the Loan Documents continues in full force and effect and secures the Obligations; and (c) agrees that this Agreement does not impair, release or otherwise affect any of those obligations or Liens. This reaffirmation does not extend any guarantee or Lien to secure the Shareholder Notes or the Saule Note. 7.2 Representations of the Loan Parties. Each Loan Party represents and warrants to the Lender that: (a) it has the corporate power and authority to execute, deliver and perform this Agreement and each Note Amendment and the Saule Note Amendment to which it is a party, and has taken all corporate action necessary to authorize them; (b) this Agreement is its legal, valid and binding obligation, enforceable against it in accordance with its terms, subject to bankruptcy, insolvency and similar laws affecting creditors’ rights generally and to general principles of equity; (c) on the Effective Date, after giving effect to the waivers contained in Article 5 , no Default or Event of Default that has not been waived under Article 5 has occurred and is continuing under the Amended Credit Agreement or the other Loan Documents; (d) each of the representations and warranties set forth in the Amended Credit Agreement and in each other Loan Document is true and correct in all material respects (without giving effect to any materiality qualifier or “Material Adverse Effect”) on and as of the date hereof (except with respect to any representation or warranty made or deemed made as of an earlier date, which shall be true and correct in all material respects (or all respects, as applicable) as of such earlier date); and (e) the execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement do not conflict with its Governing Documents, any law applicable to it, or any material agreement binding on it. 6 ARTICLE 8 – CONDITIONS TO EFFECTIVENESS 8.1 Conditions. This Agreement becomes effective on the date on which all of the following conditions have been satisfied: (a) each party has executed and delivered a counterpart of this Agreement; (b) each Note Amendment and the Saule Note Amendment has been executed and delivered by each party to it, including the Lender’s consent, and dated as of the same date, with all of its conditions satisfied other than the condition that this Agreement be effective; and (c) the representations and warranties in Section 7.2 herein are true and correct, and no Default or Event of Default (other than the Specified Matters) has occurred and is continuing; 8.2 Simultaneous Effectiveness. This Agreement, the Note Amendments and the Saule Note Amendment are interdependent. None of them becomes effective unless all of them become effective, and all of them become effective on the Effective Date. On the Effective Date, this Agreement becomes effective first, which satisfies the condition in each Note Amendment and the Saule Note Amendment that this Agreement be effective, and each of them then becomes effective immediately as part of the same closing. 8.3 Release of Claims. IN CONSIDERATION OF THE AGREEMENTS CONTAINED HEREIN THE SUFFICIENCY OF WHICH IS HEREBY ACKNOWLEDGED, THE LOAN PARTIES IRREVOCABLY RELEASES AND FOREVER DISCHARGES THE LENDER AND THE SHAREHOLDER PARTIES AND THEIR AFFILIATES AND THEIR RESPECTIVE OFFICERS, PARTNERS, DIRECTORS, TRUSTEES, EMPLOYEES AND AGENTS (TOGETHER, THE “ RELEASED PARTIES ”) OF AND FROM ALL DAMAGES, LOSSES, CLAIMS, DEMANDS, LIABILITIES, OBLIGATIONS, ACTIONS AND CAUSES OF ACTION WHATSOEVER WHICH THE LOAN PARTIES MAY NOW HAVE OR CLAIM TO HAVE ON AND AS OF THE DATE HEREOF AGAINST THE RELEASED PARTIES, WHETHER PRESENTLY KNOWN OR UNKNOWN, LIQUIDATED OR UNLIQUIDATED, SUSPECTED OR UNSUSPECTED, CONTINGENT OR NON-CONTINGENT, AND OF EVERY NATURE AND EXTENT WHATSOEVER WITH RESPECT TO THIS AGREEMENT, THE SAULE NOTE, THE SHAREHOLDER NOTES (EACH, AS AMENDED BY THIS AGREEMENT), AND THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY AND THEREBY (BUT EXCLUDING THE OBLIGATIONS OF THE RELEASED PARTIES UNDER THE NOTES, AS AMENDED BY THIS AMENDMENT) (COLLECTIVELY, “ CLAIMS ”). THE LOAN PARTIES REPRESENT AND WARRANT TO THE LENDER AND THE SHAREHOLDER PARTIES THAT IT HAS NOT GRANTED OR PURPORTED TO GRANT TO ANY OTHER PERSON ANY INTEREST WHATSOEVER IN ANY CLAIM, AS SECURITY OR OTHERWISE. THE LOAN PARTIES SHALL INDEMNIFY, DEFEND, AND HOLD HARMLESS THE RELEASED PARTIES FROM AND AGAINST ANY AND ALL CLAIMS AND ANY LOSS, COST, LIABILITY, DAMAGE OR EXPENSE (INCLUDING REASONABLE ATTORNEYS’ FEES AND EXPENSES) INCURRED BY THE RELEASED PARTIES IN INVESTIGATING, PREPARING FOR, DEFENDING AGAINST, PROVIDING EVIDENCE OR PRODUCING DOCUMENTS IN CONNECTION WITH OR TAKING OTHER ACTION IN RESPECT OF ANY COMMENCED OR THREATENED CLAIM. 7 ARTICLE 9 – NOTICES, AMENDMENTS, ETC. 9.1 Notices. Notices under this Agreement must be in writing. The methods of delivery and deemed-receipt provisions in Section 9.3 of the Credit Agreement are incorporated into this Agreement and apply to notices to every party, with the necessary changes. Notices must be addressed as follows: (a) to each Loan Party, at its address for notices under the Credit Agreement; (b) to the Lender, at [***]; (c) to each of Oxus, Soltanzadeh and Helg, at its or his respective address specified in Section 7.7 of the Conversion Agreement, which addresses are incorporated into this Agreement solely for notice purposes despite the termination of the Conversion Agreement; and (d) to each of Z Ventures and Zagros, at its respective registered office, with a copy to Soltanzadeh at the address specified in paragraph (c) above. Any party may change its address or other notice details by written notice to the other parties in accordance with this Section. 9.2 Assignments; Successors. This Agreement shall bind and inure to the benefit of the respective successors and assigns of each of the parties; provided, that, no Loan Party may assign this Agreement or any rights or duties hereunder without the Lender’s or the Shareholder Parties’ prior written consent and any prohibited assignment shall be absolutely void ab initio. No consent to assignment by the Lender or the Shareholder Parties shall release any Loan Party from its obligations in this Agreement, the Note Amendments or the Saule Note Amendment or the Obligations under the Credit Agreement. Lender may assign this Agreement, Saule Amendment, and the Loan Documents, and the Shareholder Parties may assign this Agreement and the Note Amendments, in whole or in part and their rights and duties thereunder and no consent or approval by any Loan Party is required in connection with any such assignment or participation. 9.3 Amendments; Waivers. No amendment or modification of this Agreement shall be effective unless it has been agreed to by Lender and the Shareholder Parties in a writing that specifically states that it is intended to amend or modify this Agreement. No failure by the Lender or the Shareholder Parties to exercise any right, remedy, or option under this Agreement, or delay by the Lender or the Shareholder Parties in exercising the same, will operate as a waiver thereof. No waiver by the Lender or the Shareholder Parties will be effective unless it is in writing, and then only to the extent specifically stated. No waiver by the Lender or the Shareholder Parties on any occasion shall affect or diminish the Lender’s or the Shareholder Parties’ rights thereafter to require strict performance by any Loan Party of any provision of this Agreement. The Lender’s and the Shareholder Parties’ rights under this Agreement will be cumulative and not exclusive of any other right or remedy that the Lender or the Shareholder Parties may have. 8 ARTICLE 10 – JURY TRIAL WAIVER; OTHER WAIVERS, CONSENTS; GOVERNING LAW 10.1 Governing Law. UNLESS EXPRESSLY OTHERWISE PROVIDED THEREIN, THE VALIDITY OF THIS AGREEMENT, THE CONSTRUCTION, INTERPRETATION, AND ENFORCEMENT THEREOF, THE RIGHTS OF THE PARTIES THERETO WITH RESPECT TO ALL MATTERS ARISING THEREUNDER OR RELATED THERETO, AND ANY CLAIMS, CONTROVERSIES OR DISPUTES ARISING THEREUNDER OR RELATED THERETO SHALL BE DETERMINED UNDER, GOVERNED BY, AND CONSTRUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK. 10.2 Forum Non Conveniens. THE PARTIES AGREE THAT ALL ACTIONS OR PROCEEDINGS ARISING IN CONNECTION WITH THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE TRIED AND LITIGATED ONLY IN THE STATE AND, TO THE EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, FEDERAL COURTS LOCATED IN THE COUNTY OF NEW YORK, STATE OF NEW YORK; PROVIDED , THAT , ANY SUIT SEEKING ENFORCEMENT AGAINST ANY COLLATERAL OR OTHER PROPERTY MAY BE BROUGHT, AT THE LENDER’S OPTION, IN THE COURTS OF ANY JURISDICTION WHERE LENDER ELECTS TO BRING SUCH ACTION OR WHERE SUCH COLLATERAL OR OTHER PROPERTY MAY BE FOUND. EACH LOAN PARTY, THE LENDER, AND EACH SHAREHOLDER PARTY WAIVES, TO THE EXTENT PERMITTED UNDER APPLICABLE LAW, ANY RIGHT EACH MAY HAVE TO ASSERT THE DOCTRINE OF FORUM NON CONVENIENS OR TO OBJECT TO VENUE TO THE EXTENT ANY PROCEEDING IS BROUGHT IN ACCORDANCE WITH THIS SECTION 10.2 . 10.3 WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, EACH OF THE PARTIES HEREBY WAIVE THEIR RESPECTIVE RIGHTS, IF ANY, TO A JURY TRIAL OF ANY CLAIM, CONTROVERSY, DISPUTE OR CAUSE OF ACTION DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY BASED UPON OR ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT, THE NOTE AMENDMENTS, THE SAULE NOTE AMENDMENT, THE LOAN DOCUMENTS OR ANY TRANSACTION CONTEMPLATED THEREIN, INCLUDING CONTRACT CLAIMS, TORT CLAIMS, BREACH OF DUTY CLAIMS, AND ALL OTHER COMMON LAW OR STATUTORY CLAIMS (EACH, A “ CLAIM ”). EACH PARTY REPRESENTS THAT IT HAS REVIEWED THIS WAIVER AND EACH KNOWINGLY AND VOLUNTARILY WAIVES ITS JURY TRIAL RIGHTS FOLLOWING CONSULTATION WITH LEGAL COUNSEL. IN THE EVENT OF LITIGATION, A COPY OF THIS AGREEMENT MAY BE FILED AS A WRITTEN CONSENT TO A TRIAL BY THE COURT. 9 10.4 SUBMISSION TO JURISDICTION. EACH LOAN PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY AND UNCONDITIONALLY SUBMITS TO THE EXCLUSIVE JURISDICTION OF THE STATE AND FEDERAL COURTS LOCATED IN THE COUNTY OF NEW YORK AND THE STATE OF NEW YORK, IN ANY ACTION OR PROCEEDING ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, OR FOR RECOGNITION OR ENFORCEMENT OF ANY JUDGMENT. EACH OF THE PARTIES HERETO AGREES THAT A FINAL JUDGMENT IN ANY SUCH ACTION OR PROCEEDING SHALL BE CONCLUSIVE AND MAY BE ENFORCED IN OTHER JURISDICTIONS BY SUIT ON THE JUDGMENT OR IN ANY OTHER MANNER PROVIDED BY LAW. NOTHING IN ANY LOAN DOCUMENT SHALL AFFECT ANY RIGHT THAT LENDER MAY OTHERWISE HAVE TO BRING ANY ACTION OR PROCEEDING RELATING TO ANY LOAN DOCUMENT AGAINST ANY LOAN PARTY OR ITS PROPERTIES IN THE COURTS OF ANY JURISDICTION 10.5 WAIVER OF CLAIMS. NO CLAIM MAY BE MADE BY ANY LOAN PARTY AGAINST LENDER OR ANY SHAREHOLDER PARTY OR ANY AFFILIATE, DIRECTOR, OFFICER, EMPLOYEE COUNSEL, REPRESENTATIVE, AGENT, OR ATTORNEY-IN-FACT OF ANY OF THEM FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, CONSEQUENTIAL, PUNITIVE OR EXEMPLARY DAMAGES OR LOSSES IN RESPECT OF ANY CLAIM FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT OR ANY OTHER THEORY OF LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATED TO THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED BY THIS AGREEMENT, THE NOTE AMENDMENTS, THE SAULE NOTE AMENDMENT, OR THE LOAN DOCUMENTS, OR ANY ACT, OMISSION, OR EVENT OCCURRING IN CONNECTION THEREWITH, AND EACH SUCH LOAN PARTY HEREBY WAIVES, RELEASES, AND AGREES NOT TO SUE UPON ANY CLAIM FOR SUCH DAMAGES, WHETHER OR NOT ACCRUED AND WHETHER OR NOT KNOWN OR SUSPECTED TO EXIST IN ITS FAVOR. ARTICLE 11 – GENERAL PROVISIONS 11.1 Effectiveness; Section Headings; Severability. This Agreement shall be binding and deemed effective when executed by each Loan Party, the Lender, and each Shareholder Party whose signature is provided for on the signature pages hereof. Headings and numbers have been set forth herein for convenience only. Unless the contrary is compelled by the context, everything contained in each Section applies equally to this entire Agreement. Each provision of this Agreement shall be severable from every other provision of this Agreement for the purpose of determining the legal enforceability of any specific provision. 11.2 Counterparts; Electronic Signatures. This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts and by different parties on separate counterparts, each of which, when executed and delivered, shall be deemed an original, and all of which, when taken together, shall constitute but one and the same Agreement. Execution of any such counterparty may be by means of (a) an electronic signature that complies with the federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act, state enactments of the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act, the Electronic Commerce Act, 2000 (Ontario) or any other relevant and applicable electronic signatures law; (b) an original manual signature; or (c) a faxed, scanned, or photocopied manual signature. Each electronic signature or faxed, scanned, or photocopied manual signature shall for all purposes have the same validity, legal effect, and admissibility in evidence as an original manual signature. 10 11.3 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, the Note Amendments, the Saule Note Amendment and the Loan Documents reflect the entire agreement among the parties with respect to the transactions contemplated thereby and shall not be contradicted or qualified by any other agreement, oral or written, before the Effective Date. 11.4 Further Assurances. Each party will promptly execute and deliver such further documents and take such further actions as another party reasonably requests to give effect to this Agreement, without creating any new advance, guarantee, security or other obligation not provided for in this Agreement. 11.5 Expenses. The Loan Parties agree to reimburse all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket fees, costs and expenses of the Lender and the Shareholder Parties. 11.6 Public Disclosure. Each party acknowledges that Borealis is a public company listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market and agrees that Borealis may disclose the terms of this Agreement, the Note Amendments and the Saule Note Amendment, and file copies of them, as required by applicable securities laws and stock exchange rules. 11.7 Independent Legal Advice. Each party acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to obtain independent legal advice about this Agreement and is entering into it voluntarily. 11.8 Survival; No Third-Party Rights. The termination, releases, consents and waivers in this Agreement survive the Effective Date and the repayment of any Shareholder Note, the Saule Note or the Obligations. No person other than the parties and their permitted successors and assigns has any right to enforce this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, each person expressly released under Section 8.3 herein is an intended third-party beneficiary of, and may rely on and enforce, the release and covenant not to sue therein, but has no right to enforce any other provision of this Agreement. [ Signature pages follow ] 11 The parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above. BORROWERS: PALMETTO GOURMET FOODS, INC. text: EX-10.2 3 ea031346801ex10-2.htm MASTER AMENDMENT TO PROMISSORY NOTES, DATED AS OF NOVEMBER 19, 2026, AMONG BARTHELEMY HELG, BOREALIS FOODS INC. AND PALMETTO GOURMET FOODS, INC Exhibit 10.2 EXECUTION VERSION MASTER AMENDMENT TO PROMISSORY NOTES This Master Amendment to Promissory Notes (this “ Amendment ”) is dated as of November 19, 2026 (the “ Effective Date ”) by BARTHELEMY HELG (the “ Holder ”), BOREALIS FOODS INC., an Ontario corporation (“ Borealis ”) and PALMETTO GOURMET FOODS, INC. (“ PGF ”). Borealis and PGF are each an “ Obligor ” solely in respect of the Notes for which it is identified as maker in Schedule A. The parties wish to amend each promissory note identified in Schedule A, including its prior written amendments identified there (each a “ Note ” and collectively the “ Notes ”), to establish a three year maturity and the interest treatment set out below. RECITALS A. The Obligors issued the Notes to the Holder as demand promissory notes. B. The Obligors are party to a Credit Agreement dated April 27, 2026 (the “ Credit Agreement ”), originally with Oxus Capital Pte Ltd. as lender. The lender’s rights under the Credit Agreement were assigned to Algaziyeva Saule (the “ Lender ”) by an Assignment of Loan Documents dated July 31, 2026. C. Concurrently with this Amendment, the parties to the Conversion Agreement dated April 27, 2026 (the “ Conversion Agreement ”) are terminating it under an Omnibus Amendment, Termination and Consent Agreement dated as of the Effective Date (the “ Omnibus Agreement ”). D. The Obligors and the Holder wish to amend each Note to fix its maturity and to stop the accrual of interest, on the terms of this Amendment. In consideration of their mutual covenants, the parties agree as follows: 1. Acknowledgment of Notes. Each Obligor acknowledges and agrees that each Note set out in Schedule A issued by it is outstanding and is a valid and binding obligation of that Obligor. 2. Application to each Note. Each Note is individually amended by this Amendment without a separate amendment being required for that Note. Schedule A forms part of this Amendment. Only the Notes identified in Schedule A are amended. The dates, reference amounts and currencies in Schedule A identify the instruments; they do not establish their unpaid balances or evidence additional advances. No Note held by another person is amended. 3. Maturity. Despite any term of a Note making it payable on demand or on a stated maturity date, including a date that has passed, the entire unpaid principal of each Note, together with all accrued interest, is due on the third anniversary of the Effective Date (the “ New Maturity Date ”). The Holder will not demand payment of any Note before the New Maturity Date. 4. Waiver. To the extent that, before the Effective Date, (a) any Note reached its stated maturity date without being paid, or (b) the Holder made demand for payment of any Note that was not paid, the Holder irrevocably waives any default or event of default under that Note arising from that non-payment, and any default interest, late charge, fee or other amount that accrued or could be claimed because of it. The Holder confirms that it has not accelerated, or taken any enforcement step in respect of, any Note. This waiver is limited to the matters described in this section and does not waive any other right of the Holder under the Notes. 5. Cessation of interest. From and including the Effective Date until the applicable Note is paid in full, no further contractual interest accrues or is payable on its principal, previously accrued interest or other amounts. This overrides any provision for ordinary interest, default interest, compounding, capitalization, payment in kind, or interest following acceleration or maturity. Interest does not resume because the New Maturity Date passes, a payment is overdue or an event of default occurs. The Holder shall not seek interest accruing for that period by way of an equivalent late charge or financing fee. 6. Previously accrued interest. Interest validly accrued and unpaid under a Note before the Effective Date is preserved, is not forgiven, and remains a separate unpaid amount payable with that Note on the New Maturity Date or upon an earlier permitted repayment. No interest accrues on that preserved amount from the Effective Date. Amounts remain denominated and payable in the currency of the applicable Note. 7. Continuing obligations and separate liability. Except as expressly amended, each Note remains unchanged and in full force and effect. Each Obligor remains liable only for Notes it issued, on the basis of liability already applicable to it, and does not assume or guarantee another Obligor’s debt by signing. 8. Prepayment. Each Obligor may prepay any Note in whole or in part at any time without premium or penalty, but only to the extent permitted by the Credit Agreement and any applicable subordination agreement. 9. Subordination. This Amendment does not amend or release any existing subordination agreement applicable to the Notes. 10. Effect of Amendment; No Novation. This Amendment amends the Notes and does not extinguish or novate them or the indebtedness they evidence. Each reference in a Note to “this Note” means that Note as amended by this Amendment. 11. Conditions to Effectiveness. This Amendment becomes effective on the Effective Date once (a) each party and the Lender have signed it, and (b) the Omnibus Agreement has become effective. 12. Holder Representations. The Holder represents that it is the sole legal and beneficial holder of each Note, and has not assigned, pledged or otherwise transferred any Note or any interest in a Note. 13. Authority and further assurances. Each party confirms its authority to execute and perform this Amendment. The parties shall execute reasonable further documents needed to give effect to these amendments, without increasing any party’s obligations beyond the agreement recorded here. No person signing for a corporate Holder incurs personal liability by reason only of signing in that representative capacity. 14. Original Notes. Promptly after the Effective Date, the Holder will (a) place on each original Note the legend “Amended by Master Amendment to Promissory Notes dated as of November 19, 2026”, or attach a copy of this Amendment to it as an allonge, and (b) for any original Note it cannot locate, deliver an affidavit of loss and indemnity reasonably satisfactory to the Obligors. 15. Miscellaneous. As to each Note, this Amendment is governed by the law that governs such Note. It may be signed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original and all of which together are one agreement. [Signature page to follow] SIGNATURES The parties have executed and delivered this Amendment to take effect only in accordance with section 11. Each corporate signatory signs in its stated representative capacity. BARTHELEMY HELG Signature: /s/ Barthelemy Helg Name: Barthelemy Helg BOREALIS FOODS INC. By: /s/ Reza Soltanzadeh Name: Reza Soltanzadeh Title: President & CEO PALMETTO GOURMET FOODS, INC. By: /s/ Reza Soltanzadeh Name: Reza Soltanzadeh Title: President & CEO [ Signature Page to Master Amendment to Promissory Note (Barthelemy Helg) ] LENDER CONSENT. The undersigned, as Lender under the Credit Agreement, consents to this Amendment for purposes of Section 6.6(b) of the Credit Agreement and confirms that this Amendment does not constitute a Default or Event of Default under the Credit Agreement. /s/ Saule Algaziyeva SAULE ALGAZIYEVA

text: EX-10.6 7 ea031346801ex10-6.htm AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO CONVERTIBLE PROMISSORY NOTE, DATED AS OF NOVEMBER 19, 2026, BETWEEN SAULE ALGAZIYEVA AND BOREALIS FOODS INC Exhibit 10.6 EXECUTION VERSION AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO CONVERTIBLE PROMISSORY NOTE This Amendment No. 1 to Convertible Promissory Note (this “ Amendment ”) is dated as of November 19, 2026 (the “ Effective Date ”) by SAULE ALGAZIYEVA (referred to as “Algaziyeva Saule” in the Assignments described below) (the “ Holder ”) and BOREALIS FOODS INC., an Ontario corporation (“ Borealis ” or the “ Obligor ”). The parties wish to amend the convertible promissory note identified in Schedule A, including any prior written amendments identified there (the “ Note ”), to extend its maturity date. All other terms and conditions of the Note remain the same. RECITALS A. The Obligor issued the Note to Oxus Capital Pte Ltd. (“ Oxus ”). Oxus assigned the Note to the Holder by an Assignment of Convertible Promissory Note dated as of July 31, 2026, and the Holder is now its sole holder. B. The Obligor is party to a Credit Agreement dated April 27, 2026 (the “ Credit Agreement ”), originally with Oxus as lender. Oxus’s rights as lender under the Credit Agreement were also assigned to the Holder (in that capacity, the “ Lender ”) by an Assignment of Loan Documents dated July 31, 2026. C. The Note had a stated maturity date of August 29, 2026 (the “ Original Maturity Date ”) and was not paid on that date. D. The Obligor and the Holder wish to extend the maturity of the Note to May 1, 2027 and to waive the resulting payment default, with all other terms of the Note unchanged, on the terms of this Amendment. In consideration of their mutual covenants, the parties agree as follows: 1. Acknowledgment of Note. The Obligor acknowledges and agrees that the Note is outstanding and is a valid and binding obligation of the Obligor. 2. Extension of maturity. Despite the Original Maturity Date, the entire unpaid principal of the Note, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, is due on May 1, 2027 (the “ New Maturity Date ”), with effect from the Original Maturity Date. Each reference in the Note to its maturity date means the New Maturity Date. 3. Waiver. The Holder irrevocably waives any default or event of default under the Note arising from its non-payment on the Original Maturity Date or at any time before the Effective Date, and any default interest, late charge, fee or other amount that accrued or could be claimed because of that non-payment. The Holder confirms that neither she nor, to her knowledge, Oxus has made demand for payment of, accelerated, or taken any enforcement step in respect of, the Note. This waiver is limited to the matters described in this section and does not waive any other right of the Holder under the Note. 4. Interest. Interest continues to accrue on the Note at the rate of 10% per annum, as provided in the Note, including for the period from the Original Maturity Date to the New Maturity Date, and is payable as provided in the Note. No default interest accrues for any period before the Effective Date. 5. Continuing obligations. Except as expressly amended by this Amendment, the Note remains unchanged and in full force and effect on the same terms and conditions. 6. Subordination. This Amendment does not amend or release any existing subordination agreement applicable to the Note. 7. Effect of Amendment; No Novation. This Amendment amends the Note and does not extinguish or novate it or the indebtedness it evidences. Each reference in the Note to “this Note” means the Note as amended by this Amendment. 8. Conditions to Effectiveness. This Amendment becomes effective on the Effective Date once (a) each party has signed it and the Lender has signed the Lender consent below[, and (b) the Omnibus Amendment, Termination and Consent Agreement among the Obligor, the Holder and others dated as of the Effective Date has become effective]. 9. Holder Representations. The Holder represents that she is the sole legal and beneficial holder of the Note, and has not assigned, pledged or otherwise transferred the Note or any interest in it. 10. Authority and further assurances. Each party confirms its authority to execute and perform this Amendment. The parties shall execute reasonable further documents needed to give effect to this Amendment, without increasing any party’s obligations beyond the agreement recorded here. 11. Original Note. Promptly after the Effective Date, the Holder will (a) place on the original Note the legend “Amended by Amendment No. 1 to Convertible Promissory Note dated as of November 19, 2026”, or attach a copy of this Amendment to it as an allonge, and (b) if she cannot locate the original Note, deliver an affidavit of loss and indemnity reasonably satisfactory to the Obligor. 12. Miscellaneous. This Amendment is governed by the law that governs the Note. It may be signed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original and all of which together are one agreement.
